65-075.r: Wrong pair: Rayon – modified starch; rayon is regenerated cellulose fibre (from wood). Correct: oxytocin–hormone, aspartame–synthetic sweetener, neoprene–specialised rubber.

65-076.r: Wrong pair: Rayon – modified starch; rayon is regenerated cellulose fibre. Correct: wool–protein, rubber–natural polymer, fullerene–allotrope of carbon.

65-077.r: Silk fibre, hair, nails and claws → made of keratin protein.

65-078.r: Cotton → NOT a protein (almost pure cellulose, grows in a boll around seeds); hair, spider silk and hoof are proteins.

65-079.r: Sunn hemp (Crotalaria juncea, legume family Fabaceae, from India) → plant fibre obtained from the stem; also green manure and fodder.

65-080.r: Bull semen for artificial insemination → stored in liquid nitrogen (–320°F; no fertility loss with age); dry ice-alcohol (–100°F) loses fertility.

65-082.r: Kadaknath ('Kali Masi', black-fleshed) → Indian chicken (fowl) breed from Dhar and Jhabua, Madhya Pradesh; meat got GI tag on 30 July 2018.

65-083.r: Holstein-Friesian → world's highest milk-yielding cow breed (Netherlands origin), about 25,000 pounds of milk per lactation.

65-084.r: Wrong pair: Sheep – Tharparkar; Tharparkar is a cow breed. Correct: buffalo–Bhadawari, cow–Sindhi, goat–Jamunapari.

65-085.r: Rashtriya Gokul Mission → conserve and develop indigenous cow breeds; Rs 500 crore in the 12th Five Year Plan.

65-086.r: Myoglobin → muscle cell; Sarpgandha → tranquilizer; Carcinoma → radiotherapy; Haemoglobin → oxygen transport.

65-087.r: Bulimia → eating disorder; Cholesterol → egg-yolk; Atropine → alkaloid; Insulin → pancreas.

65-088.r: Indian scientists' diode of cadmium sulphide nanoparticles → made using yeast Schizosaccharomyces pombe; useful in device miniaturisation.

65-089.r: Anaesthetics → chloroform and nitrous oxide (1, 2); nitrous oxide = mild anaesthetic gas. First: diethyl ether by Morton, 1846; chloroform by Simpson, 1847.

65-091.r: Cardiologist → heart; Nephrologist → kidney; Urologist → urinary tract; Oculist → eye.

65-092.r: Neurology → nervous system (correct). Cardiology → heart, circulation; Gastroenterology → digestive system; Urology → urinary tract.

65-093.r: Colostrum → NOT banned for athletes (IOC calls it a safe supplement); human growth hormone, testosterone, erythropoietin are banned.

65-094.r: Wrong pair: Saccharin – carbohydrate; saccharin is a synthetic artificial sweetener (300-400 times sweeter than sucrose). Correct: adrenaline–hormone, thiamine–vitamin, keratin–protein.

65-095.r: Wrong pair: Antiseptic – phenolphthalein; it is an acid-base indicator (also laxative). Correct: nucleus–control centre, natural rubber–polyisoprene, cryolite–aluminium ore.

65-096.r: Saheli → CDRI Lucknow's centchroman (ormeloxifene) pill, marketed by HLL; world's first non-steroidal oral contraceptive (1991), taken once a week.

65-097.r: Contraceptive pills (regular and emergency) → mainly synthetic progestogen levonorgestrel.

65-098.r: Monitoring foetal growth → ultrasonics (ultrasound imaging), not X-rays.

65-099.r: Birbal Sahni → paleobotany; K.C. Mehta → plant pathology; P. Maheshwari → embryology; M.S. Swaminathan → Green Revolution.

65-101.r: Invasive Species Specialist Group (manages Global Invasive Species Database, developed 1998-2000) → belongs to IUCN.

65-102.r: India (April 2025) is NOT party to the Occupational Safety and Health Convention; it is party to CITES (1976), World Heritage Convention (1977), IWC (since 1981).

65-103.r: Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI) → Izatnagar, Bareilly (Uttar Pradesh).

65-106.r: Survey of India (national mapping agency, set up 1767) → under Ministry of Science and Technology.
